change_summary: Add manual-only NCAA (basketball_ncaab, americanfootball_ncaaf) pregame/close Odds API snapshot intake with a 3-credit pre-computed budget, free remaining-credit preflight, per sport+snapshot+Central-date artifact claim, Fernet-encrypted archive, and paper-card-compatible raw+manifest output. Additive artifact-gate pilots; NFL and ratings paths unchanged.
assumptions: Sport keys, markets and cost formula come from The Odds API v4 documentation, not a live response; billing headers are re-checked after the call and mismatches create a quota hold.
The free /v4/sports endpoint is documented to return x-requests-remaining without consuming quota.
Card compatibility: merged CBB (#403) and CFB (#404) paper-card Odds API loaders are exercised in-repo by synthetic tests only; both cards are unvalidated PAPER models.
Aggregator quotes are not upstream sportsbook authentication; nothing here verifies an edge.
